name: dsh-launcher
description: Harness Launcher - Tauri macOS menubar app to manage the DeepSeek Harness engine

scripts.build: npm run assets && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.lint: biome check scripts src-tauri/resources/overlay.js src-tauri/resources/findzoom.js src-tauri/resources/settings.js src-tauri/resources/stopped.js
scripts.format: biome check --write scripts src-tauri/resources/overlay.js src-tauri/resources/findzoom.js src-tauri/resources/settings.js src-tauri/resources/stopped.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && node scripts/test-panel-feed.mjs && node scripts/test-findzoom.mjs && node scripts/test-stopped-i18n.mjs && node scripts/test-csp.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n-sync.mjs && node scripts/test-events.mjs
